material_findings: Source, corpus, and result publication had no post-publication code/input custody recheck; a concurrent change after the final pre-publication check could leave an artifact published under stale reviewed bytes.
The independent validator ran in a separate process but reused runner parity and evaluation functions, so shared recurrence or evaluation defects could pass both execution and validation paths.
disposition: V15 sealed without an acceptance receipt, acquisition, model effects, or published result. A fresh V16 identity is required for correction.
